notes: Fifteen pieces for a Rekindled camp, all grade B or better and almost all tagged 'camp'. 'kind' says which outcome they suit: hearth (what a campfire can leave behind), shelter, bedding, provisions and trail (relics left along a route). Catalog tiers run from common (kindling, a campfire, a bedroll) up to the whole Hunter's Camp as the extremely-rare showpiece, so the humblest camping outcome is a small, useful-looking keepsake and the rarest is a full camp tableau. Other camp-tagged pieces (extra tents, the camp kitchen, skinner's and hunter's poles, tool and cookware sets) are held back on purpose for the artisan and BOD pools, so the camping set stays about the fire, the bedroll and the trail.
